ledger: Truck | White/silver cab visible in opening exterior shot | Dark green cab with white stripes visible in later exterior shots | Vehicle appearance changes between scenes

findings.description: The semi-truck parked outside the diner changes appearance. In the opening shot (00:00), the cab appears white or light silver. In subsequent shots (00:27, 01:41), the truck is dark green with white stripes. It is implausible for the vehicle to change color without explanation.
